registration: none (no OSF for v2, Mahdi 2026-10-30); this file and its checksum are the record

notebooks.ghe2_route_E: route E: the best genre guesser names the genre; the best judge for that genre (judge x genre table of the learn half) judges. Asked for the genre: the guesser only.
notebooks.ghe2_route_F: route F (own genre): every LLM with an own-genre cell names the genre; the LLM with the lowest learn-half BHS inside the genre it named judges (tie: lower overall BHS); no cell: A.
notebooks.ghe2_route_R: route R (best path): the lower learn-half score of the our-genre path (as E) and the own-genre paths of the lock's askers.
notebooks.ghe2_single_best: A: the single best judge of the learn half judges every answer.

main_tests.method: paired bootstrap over test questions, 10,000 re-samples, seed 2026, two-sided; BHS with no_answer as an error; labels as above

also_reported: each route's own cost (calls, tokens, time)
every route vs A on all answers together
determinism: same (judge, answer) must give the same verdict in every notebook
supersedes: pool.json main_tests (R vs A and F vs A, Holm over 4)
